Markets.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
Markets.summary: Reliance Industries reported a 41% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27. The company's revenue also surged by 29% compared to the same period in the previous year.

Markets.title: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-over-year increase in second-quarter profit to Rs 8,389 crore alongside an 11% rise in revenue. This financial growth was driven by strong subscriber additions, the expansion of digital services, and a slight increase in average revenue per user.

Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq tumbles over 2%, S&P 1% at open as Amazon, Intel add to AI spending woes
Markets.summary: US stocks opened sharply lower on Friday, with the Nasdaq tumbling over 2% and the S&P 500 dropping 1%. The decline was driven by investor concerns over aggressive artificial intelligence spending plans from Amazon and a cash burn warning from Intel.

Markets.title: NTPC Green Energy Q2 Results: Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 137 crore, revenue rises 53%
Markets.summary: NTPC Green Energy reported a 56% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 137.5 crore for the second quarter of FY27. This financial growth was driven by a 53% rise in revenue and an expanded operational renewable energy portfolio.

Markets.title: Big dividends, bigger losses? The hidden risk in Wall Street's highest-yielding stocks
Markets.summary: Several U.S. stocks, led by mortgage REITs Annaly Capital Management and AGNC Investment, offer dividend yields exceeding 10%. However, significant share-price declines highlight major risks regarding their dividend sustainability, debt, and overall returns.

Markets.title: India bonds buckle for fourth straight month on oil's climb
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds fell for the fourth consecutive month in October due to surging Brent crude oil prices and the Reserve Bank of India's first policy rate hike in nearly four years. Additionally, foreign investments in Indian bonds dropped to a four-month low, heightening concerns over the rupee's performance.

Geo-Political.title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
Geo-Political.summary: Incarcerated US woman Christa Pike has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a failed lethal injection attempt in September. Pike stated that she woke up confused and in pain following the botched execution procedure.

Geo-Political.title: Residents leave devastated Russian-occupied Oleshky as evacuation corridor opens
Geo-Political.summary: An evacuation corridor has opened in the Russian-occupied frontline town of Oleshky as residents flee the devastated area. Despite the lack of basic utilities like gas, electricity, and running water, several hundred people have chosen to remain.

Geo-Political.title: Prominent Russian newspaper shuts down under pressure from authorities
Geo-Political.summary: Independent Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta has shut down after facing intense pressure from state authorities. The outlet operated as one of Russia's most prominent independent news sources for the past thirty years.

Geo-Political.title: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Spain's transport minister, Óscar Puente, has refused to resign following a high-speed train collision earlier in the week that killed at least 69 people. Puente has faced widespread calls to step down in the wake of the disaster.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
Geo-Political.summary: Erin Patterson lost her appeal after three judges dismissed all seven grounds in which she argued her murder trial was unfair. She was convicted of using poisonous mushrooms to kill three people.

Geo-Political.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
Geo-Political.summary: Syrians are facing severe discontent due to the end of subsidies and soaring prices following the fall of the Assad regime. This economic crisis is directly testing public support for the new government led by Ahmed al-Sharaa.

Data & Insights.summary: The West Asia conflict has increased working-capital demand at Indian banks by 15-20% due to higher raw-material costs and shipping delays. This surge in borrowing has helped drive corporate credit growth during the September quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What does the proposed India-Mexico preferential trade agreement mean for Indian exporters?
Data & Insights.summary: A proposed preferential trade agreement could help Indian exporters improve price competitiveness in Mexico. This improvement would come through negotiated tariff concessions between the two countries.

Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry reports that recent GST reforms will help the Indian economy maintain a high-growth trajectory in fiscal year 2027. However, the Department of Economic Affairs notes that ongoing global uncertainties like elevated oil prices and inflation require constant vigilance.

Data & Insights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang names 3 countries leading in tech, manufacturing: Which are they? Does India make the list?
Data & Insights.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identified the United States, China, and Taiwan as the world's leading nations in technology and manufacturing, excluding India from his list. He noted that China's strength stems from combining industrial production with computer science.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: India's public debt-to-GDP ratio is projected to drop from 84.3% in fiscal year 2026 to 75.1% by fiscal year 2032. According to RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta, India is the only emerging market economy with a GDP over $1 trillion expected to reduce its public debt during this period.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September compared to 8% in August. This expansion was driven by strong performances in the manufacturing and electricity sectors despite a decline in mining.

India.title: Delhi Air Quality Drops To 78 After Record Rain Brings Winter Chill
India.summary: Record rain in Delhi lowered the air quality index to 78 and brought a winter chill to the region. According to the IMD, the weather is expected to become drier with partly cloudy skies on October 31 and November 1 before clearing up.

India.title: Video: Rafale Marine Jet Touches Down On INS Vikrant For First Time
India.summary: A Rafale Marine jet has successfully landed on the INS Vikrant aircraft carrier for the first time. The Indian Navy previously contracted 26 of these aircraft, with delivery expected by late 2028 or early 2029.

India.title: Delhi Pilot, Bengaluru Cop And Lawyer Among 6 Dead In Uttarakhand Chopper Crash
India.summary: A helicopter crash in Uttarakhand killed six people, including a Delhi pilot, a Bengaluru cop, and a lawyer. The Trans Bharat Aviation aircraft had taken off from Badrinath on Friday afternoon before the fatal incident occurred.
